aboutBody.message: Net Profit for eBay Sellers shows a live net-profit and margin badge on the eBay sell form, plus a persistent profit column on your Seller Hub Active Listings grid. It reads only the price and category you already typed. No scraping, no accounts, nothing leaves your browser.

aboutPrivacyBody.message: Does not handle user data. Defaults and per-listing overrides live in browser storage on your machine. No server, no account, no data egress.
